details:
When I hang out with friends in a large instance, I want to be able to get notified if a friend joins or leaves the instance.

For example in a large game world which is hard to figure out, if I'm halfway in and a friend joins, I want to know about it instantly so that I can respawn and guide my friend on how to catch up and join the group in the world, otherwise they might just get frustrated and leave.

Or if a friend walks out of my vision and leaves the instance, I want to know they left and not just assume they're there, sometimes people crash randomly and you don't realize and this makes it easy to be aware of right away to message them on discord etc.

Or especially in public instances like the great pug with 40+ people, it helps to know if a friend of your joined, because they're most likely there to talk to you, so you can go and find them and say hi. Without join notifier, you won't even know they joined, and they'll have to go looking for you for a while, which is just annoying for both parties.

This is as easy to do as a popup at the corner of the screen that gives you the name of a person who joins or leaves the instance.
title: Feature Request: Join Notifier
